lore_anchors.definition: A metaphysical flame that burns a cultivator from within based on their negative karma; Ji Ning is still suffering its lingering effects but has gained insights from the experience.
A mysterious, will-based power distinct from Ki or Divine Power, with five known levels; it is a closely guarded unique technique of the Three Realms.
The Fiendgod Body Refining equivalent of a Celestial Immortal; a being with an immortal body and no vital points, capable of incredible physical power.
A True God or Ancestral Immortal who has fully mastered a Grand Dao; the supreme rulers of the Three Realms.
A power that naturally manifests at a Sword Immortal's blade when they fully master the Grand Dao of the Sword and seek its deeper essence.
An alien world and civilization that was used to train warriors, whose master tried to steal the Heartforce cultivation method from Ji Ning.
One of the seven Empyrean Gods under Patriarch Subhuti, formerly a follower of Daoist Threelives; his blood was used to test Ji Ning in the War God Hall.
The personal domain of the ancient Fiendgod, Daoist Threelives, which now serves as a haven for his remaining followers.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't the aliens just kill Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Their master was using Ji Ning as a living test subject to sense his Heartforce fluctuations and deduce the secret of its cultivation, a technique the Three Realms must not lose.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What are the five levels of Heartforce?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Level 1 gives a negligible boost, Level 2 a clear increase, Level 3 a massive surge, Level 4 is the current peak, and Level 5 is an unattainable legend that allows an Empyrean God to rival a Daofather.
